study_title: Botensilimab, Balstilimab and Regorafenib for the Treatment of Patients With Microsatellite Stable Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Who Have Progressed on Prior Chemotherapy
conditions: Stage III Colorectal Cancer AJCC v8
Stage IV Colorectal Cancer AJCC v8
brief_summary: This phase I/II trial tests how well botensilimab, balstilimab, and regorafenib works in treating patients with microsatellite stable colorectal cancer that has spread and who have progressed on prior chemotherapy.
detailed_description: Combination immunotherapy with botensilimab and balstilimab plus regorafenib may improve outcomes. The primary objectives are to identify the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) and to estimate response rate (ORR).
inclusion_criteria: Documented informed consent; age >= 18; ECOG <= 1; life expectancy >= 3 months; histologically/ cytologically confirmed MSS mCRC; progression after specified chemotherapy; measurable metastatic disease; adequate organ function; specific requirements for women/men of childbearing potential.
exclusion_criteria: Prior immunotherapy targeting PD-1, PD-L1, or CTLA-4; need for systemic immunosuppression; prior transplant; recent surgery; hypersensitivity; active or history of autoimmune disease; uncontrolled hypertension; cardiovascular events; active bleeding, severe toxicity; brain metastases except as described; second malignancy requiring treatment; interstitial lung disease; psychiatric/substance abuse interfering with study compliance; uncontrolled HIV/HBV/HCV infection; pregnancy/lactation.

study_title: Comparison of A140 and Erbitux Combined With mfolfox6 to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of First-line Treatment for Ras Wild-type mCRC
lead_sponsor_name: Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical Research Institute Co., Ltd.
brief_summary: Compare the objective remission rate of A140 and Erbitux combined with mfolfox6 regimen in the first-line treatment of Ras wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer for 12 weeks.
detailed_description: Randomized, double-blind, controlled trial comparing efficacy and safety of A140 or Erbitux plus mfolfox6 as first-line therapy in RAS wild-type mCRC patients.
inclusion_criteria: Age 18-75; signed informed consent; histologically proven diagnosis of metastatic colorectal cancer; no prior systemic chemotherapy for metastatic CRC; RAS wild-type (KRAS, NRAS) and BRAF-V600E negative; measurable lesion per RECIST1.1; ECOG 0-1; life expectancy ≥16 weeks; adequate organ and hematologic function.
exclusion_criteria: Known drug allergy; recent local treatment or surgery; brain/leptomeningeal metastases; bowel obstruction; active severe clinical infection; uncontrolled diabetes or severe lung/liver disease; significant cardiovascular disease; renal replacement; Grade >1 peripheral neuropathy; previous organ/stem cell transplant; history of other malignancy (except specified) within 5 years; HIV/HBV/HCV infection; coagulation dysfunction; prior VEGF or EGFR-targeted therapy; prior experimental/immunotherapy/hormone therapy as defined; pregnancy/lactation; alcohol/drug dependence; active psychiatric/neurological disease; unresolved adverse events from prior therapy.

study_title: A Study of Encorafenib Plus Cetuximab With or Without Chemotherapy in People With Previously Untreated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Evaluate encorafenib plus cetuximab alone or with standard chemotherapy versus current standard-of-care chemotherapy in patients with previously untreated BRAF V600E-mutant mCRC.
detailed_description: Open-label, multicenter, randomized phase 3 study with safety lead-in, evaluating Encorafenib plus Cetuximab with/without chemotherapy vs. standard therapy.
inclusion_criteria: Age ≥16 for Phase 3; confirmed Stage IV CRC with BRAF V600E mutation; 0-1 prior regimens in metastatic setting, measurable disease per RECIST 1.1, ECOG 0-1, adequate organ function.
exclusion_criteria: MSI-H/dMMR unless immune checkpoint inhibitor not possible; active infections in prior 2 weeks; symptomatic brain metastasis.

study_title: Clinical Trial of an Anti-cancer Drug, CA-4948 (Emavusertib), in Combination With Chemotherapy Treatment (FOLFOX Plus Bevacizumab) in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
conditions: Stage III Colorectal Cancer AJCC v8
Stage IV Colorectal Cancer AJCC v8
brief_summary: Phase I trial of CA-4948 (emavusertib) in combination with FOLFOX and bevacizumab for metastatic colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Assess dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs), safety, pharmacodynamics, and pharmacokinetics of CA-4948/FOLFOX/bevacizumab, with dose escalation and expansion.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically/cytologically confirmed colorectal adenocarcinoma, unresectable/metastatic disease measurable by RECIST 1.1; age ≥18; ECOG ≤2; adequate organ function; ability and willingness for informed consent.
exclusion_criteria: MSI-H or dMMR CRC; prolonged QTcF >450ms; unresolved toxicity from prior therapy; prior chemotherapy/antiangiogenic agents; known DPD deficiency; severe infection; pregnancy/lactation; other specified illnesses.

study_title: A Study of CTX-009 in Adult Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (COMPANION-003)
brief_summary: Open-label, adaptive Simon Two-Stage study evaluating efficacy of CTX-009 in metastatic colorectal cancer after two or three prior systemic therapy regimens.
detailed_description: Simon Two-Stage adaptive design, ~37 patients first stage, additional 47 if criteria met, total ~84. CTX-009 for post-progression/relapse mCRC after specified prior regimens.
inclusion_criteria: Age ≥18, histologically/cytologically proven mCRC with >3mo since resection, progression post 2-3 prior systemic therapies incl. fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, irinotecan, bevacizumab ± anti-EGFR for RAS wild-type; targeted therapies for available mutations; RECIST v1.1 measurable lesion; ECOG 0-1; life expectancy ≥12 weeks; adequate hepatic/renal function; negative pregnancy test; contraception reqs; signed consent.
exclusion_criteria: ≤4 weeks since major surgery/radiation/chemo/targeted therapy/immunotherapy; recent CV events (as described); uncontrolled CNS metastasis (asymptomatic allowed); active hemorrhage/diathesis; recent GI disease/events; need for antiplatelet/anticoagulants; need for chronic NSAIDs/systemic corticosteroids; severe active infection; active HBV/HCV, uncontrolled illnesses; abnormal ECG/QTcF >450ms.
